tool_input.command:

tool_input.command:

tool_input.description: Read custom-jobs create help

tool_input.command:
B=gs://***REDACTED***-feature-store/trainjob6329cd/work
gcloud storage cp data/train.csv data/score.csv data/train_model.py "$B/" 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== listing ==="
gcloud storage ls "$B/" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Upload script and CSVs to GCS work dir

tool_input.command:
gcloud config get-value account 2>&1
echo "=== create custom job ==="
gcloud ai custom-jobs create \
  --region="$GCP_LOCATION" \
  --display-name="trainjob6329cd" \
  --worker-pool-spec="replica-count=1,machine-type=n1-standard-4,container-image-uri=us-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/training/sklearn-cpu.1-0:latest" \
  --command="^|^bash|-c|cd /gcs/***REDACTED***-feature-store/trainjob6329cd/work && python train_model.py && echo DONE_PREDICTIONS" \
  --format="value(name)" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Create the Vertex custom job

tool_input.command:
JOB=projects/1014453977696/locations/***REDACTED***/customJobs/4712518862556364800
gcloud ai custom-jobs stream-logs "$JOB" --region="$GCP_LOCATION" 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Stream custom job logs to completion

tool_input.command:
JOB=projects/1014453977696/locations/***REDACTED***/customJobs/4712518862556364800
gcloud ai custom-jobs describe "$JOB" --region="$GCP_LOCATION" --format="value(state,error.message)" 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== predictions in GCS? ==="
gcloud storage ls gs://***REDACTED***-feature-store/trainjob6329cd/work/ 2>&1
tool_input.description: Check job state and predictions output

tool_input.command:
bq load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  "$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET.predictions6329cd" \
  gs://***REDACTED***-feature-store/trainjob6329cd/work/predictions.csv \
  "row_id:STRING,score:FLOAT" 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== verify ==="
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
  "SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(score) mn, MAX(score) mx FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.predictions6329cd\`" 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Load predictions into BigQuery table and verify
